recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-49949 unless a future editorial decision intentionally chooses a different citation style than the already-applied numbered markers and separate list items.
issue_request: FHIR-49949 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for the FHIR-core Device page asking whether the UDI section formatting was proper where two clarifying statements appeared as asterisk-prefixed text; the approved resolution was to replace the asterisks with 1 and 2 and place a line break between the two clarifying statements.
initial_application: Jira comments cite PR #3532. Commit a18833e329b1c539d8b92c89992397b45da03b20 converted the single paragraph containing the non-UDI and GTIN clarifications into an ordered list with separate list items, commit 1b91c978bb60aae3d38144ae00ca629e560cec6e changed the corresponding UDI component markers from asterisks to numbered markers, and merge commit 202b5af503853e71e3a5aa765693ed6a95d93ca2 integrated that PR.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists device=Device, so source/device/device-notes.xml is an active current-build source input. OO/HCP Confluence minutes from 2025-04-14 record the same FHIR-49949 disposition and 6-0-0 vote. Later commits to the same file adjusted headings or unrelated Device narrative text without reverting the UDI list formatting. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because current source/device/device-notes.xml already contains (1) and (2) markers and separate ordered-list items for the non-UDI and GTIN clarifications, and stale asterisk wording was not found elsewhere in active source.
